project.name: Finance Platform Implementation
project.description: A detailed project plan for launching an internal finance operations platform with ledger setup, invoicing, reporting, compliance controls, integrations, and rollout work.

issues.title: Define finance workspace operating model
issues.description: Document the finance workspace structure, user roles, approval boundaries, naming conventions, reporting cadence, and ownership model before implementation begins.

issues.title: Map chart of accounts
issues.description: Create account codes for assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, payroll, cloud infrastructure, software, tax, and professional services. Confirm code ranges and balance expectations.

issues.title: Define import and export acceptance criteria
issues.description: Validate that finance and project JSON exports can be imported into a clean workspace, create the expected workspace records, and preserve rows that do not depend on original database IDs.

issues.title: Build core finance workspace records
issues.description: Configure accounts, transaction categories, budgets, goals, recurring costs, debt tracking, invoices, vendor bills, and the initial ledger examples needed by the Finance Manager.

issues.title: As a finance lead, I can review open invoices and revenue schedules
issues.description: Create sample AR data for sent, paid, and draft invoices; recurring billing plans; dunning campaigns; and revenue recognition schedules so the AR views feel populated and useful.

issues.title: As an accountant, I can track vendor bills and purchase orders
issues.description: Set up sample accounts payable records with bill dates, due dates, itemized line details, statuses, procurement records, and expected review ownership.

issues.title: Verify imported JSON does not rely on original account IDs
issues.description: Finance import creates new account IDs. Confirm sample transactions use null account references or update import mapping before including linked account references.

issues.title: Automate close, reporting, and compliance workflows
issues.description: Prepare period close tasks, exchange rate examples, audit logs, compliance roles, management reporting expectations, and manual review points for month-end operations.

issues.title: Create month-end close checklist
issues.description: Add close tasks for bank reconciliation, AR review, accruals, financial package generation, and final sign-off. Include blocked and in-progress examples for dashboard testing.

issues.title: Prepare reporting review notes
issues.description: Write management reporting guidance for cash position, burn rate, invoice aging, budget variance, deferred revenue, and AP exposure.

issues.title: Launch finance workspace to team
issues.description: Complete import verification, document workflows, invite team members, validate role permissions, and run a final smoke test across all finance modules.

issues.title: Run import smoke test in a clean workspace
issues.description: Import both JSON files into DawnDesk, confirm the created projects appear, open core views, inspect counts, and capture issues before rollout.

strategies.name: Product Vision
strategies.markdown:
# Product Vision

Create a reliable finance workspace that gives operators one place to understand cash, revenue, spend, approvals, close status, and compliance readiness.

## Target Outcomes

- Finance leads can inspect accounts, budgets, invoices, vendor bills, assets, tax codes, and audit logs without starting from empty screens.
- Project teams can track launch work in a dedicated DawnDesk Project Manager workspace.
- Imports remain portable and avoid dependencies on original database IDs.
- The sample data demonstrates real operating scenarios: payroll, cloud infrastructure, recurring revenue, vendor bills, fixed assets, and month-end close.

strategies.name: Implementation Plan
strategies.markdown:
# Implementation Plan

## Phase 1: Foundation

Confirm workspace schema, project import shape, finance import shape, and role model.

## Phase 2: Finance Data

Populate accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, subscriptions, debts, invoices, chart of accounts, journal entries, vendor bills, assets, procurement, inventory, tax codes, close tasks, and AR automation examples.

## Phase 3: Verification

Import into a clean workspace, open dashboard modules, check JSON parser behavior, and verify records are usable after new IDs are generated.

## Phase 4: Rollout

Document the workflow, invite the right members, and use Project Manager to track launch readiness.

strategies.name: Risk Register
strategies.markdown:
# Risk Register

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Imported finance rows reference original IDs | Transactions or related views may not link correctly | Use null references or implement import-time ID mapping |
| Required Supabase tables are missing | Import fails before workspace creation finishes | Confirm migrations are applied before testing |
| Users import project JSON while signed out | Project creation fails | Confirm cloud account is signed in before import |
| Sample data is mistaken for production data | Reporting confusion | Keep names generic and review before operational use |

strategies.name: Rollout Checklist
strategies.markdown:
# Rollout Checklist

- Import the finance JSON from the Finance Projects screen.
- Import the Project Manager JSON from the Workspaces screen.
- Open each finance module and confirm data appears.
- Review imported Project Manager sprints, issues, versions, and strategies.
- Invite accountants and viewers with the correct roles.
- Run one month-end close walkthrough using the sample period close tasks.
- Export the workspace again after edits to confirm round-trip behavior.
